recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血抹片中許多紅血球中央淡染區呈細長裂縫或嘴形（口形紅血球），左下角有一顆小淋巴球可作大小對照，口形紅血球分布於整個視野，符合口形紅血球增多症。
features: Many red cells with elongated slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes)
Stomatocytes are normocytic to slightly macrocytic compared with the small lymphocyte at lower left
Mild anisocytosis; some cells show bowl-like cupped appearance
A few small refractile granules overlying red cells likely represent platelets or debris
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin at lower left
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows numerous erythrocytes with a linear, slit-like or mouth-shaped zone of central pallor, consistent with stomatocytes, distributed across the field. The red cells show mild anisocytosis, and a few overlying small granules likely represent platelets. A small mature lymphocyte is present at the lower left. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis, which may be hereditary (overhydrated or dehydrated forms) or acquired, as in alcohol use or liver disease; artifact should be excluded on a fresh smear.

ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes are confined to thick areas of the smear and are absent on a freshly prepared, rapidly dried smear.
Spherocytes lack any central pallor and appear small and dense, unlike the slit pallor here.
Rh-null shows stomatocytes and spherocytes with absent Rh antigens on red cell typing, which cannot be distinguished from other stomatocytosis on morphology alone.
